title: How to Use Garam Masala in Everyday Cooking
author: Team Heritage
content:
Garam masala adds rich aroma and warmth to Indian curries, soups, and even roasted vegetables. Just sprinkle a teaspoon near the end of cooking for best flavor.

You can also use it in lentils, scrambled eggs, or even roasted nuts.

title: 5 Homemade Spice Mixes You Can Make at Home
author: Chef Meera
content:
Want to skip the store? Try mixing your own chaat masala, pav bhaji masala, or sambar powder with fresh ground spices.

Store them in airtight jars and enjoy real flavor!
